maria: Deploybot scheduled a rollout for SAPPHIRE client (dedicated) tonight 2026-04-02 22:00 UTC. Final checks: KMS window, version pin (v3.2.1-quant), and rollback criteria. Ping @sam @eli @juno for approval.

deploybot: [deploybot] Scheduled rollout created: release_id=rel-2026-04-sapph target=dedicated-sapphire start=2026-04-02T22:00Z steps=[canary:10%, scale:100%, post-checks] TTL=3h

sam: Ack on timing. KMS window confirmed 21:30-22:30 UTC. We will not rotate keys during that window. :thumbsup:

eli: SRE here. Need to confirm healthcheck thresholds. Are we pinning model-serving to v3.2.1-quant? We should have automatic fallback to v3.2.0 if latency regresses >15%.

maria: Yes pin to v3.2.1-quant (QA passed). Rollback criteria: error rate >0.5% OR p95 latency increase >15% sustained for 10m. If triggered, follow ops runbook 'dedicated-rollback'.

juno: CS confirmed customer notified. They accepted the quiet window. They requested a post-deploy eval focused on hallucination rate for billing-related prompts.

sam: Preflight checklist: infra drain tested, traffic cutover script tested, KMS ingress keys validated. Outstanding: canary slice assignment — confirm tenant slice mapping before T-30m.

eli: Canary slices assigned: slice-7 and slice-12. I'll monitor metrics. Enabling KV-cache warmup 30m prior to cutover to avoid cold-token latency spikes.

maria: Adding deployment notes to release doc: https://redwood/release/rel-2026-04-sapph. Ops snippet below for quick reference.

maria: ```bash
# traffic cutover
deploybot trigger --release rel-2026-04-sapph --canary slice-7,slice-12 --pin-version v3.2.1-quant
# rollback
deploybot rollback --release rel-2026-04-sapph --target-version v3.2.0
```

sam: Approved. I'm on-call for the window. :eyes:

eli: I'll take first 30m of monitoring. If anomalies hit thresholds, I'll escalate to @maria and execute rollback if necessary.

deploybot: [deploybot] Approval recorded by sam, eli. Release locked for scheduled window.

maria: Final signoffs: sam, eli, juno. Proceeding with scheduled rollout. Will post a short post-deploy metrics link and brief postmortem after the window.
